description: Every voice channel has its own text chat. Voice chat cleanup stops members from using that chat while nobody is in the voice channel. Any message sent there while the voice channel is empty is deleted, and Wynem posts a warning in its place.

description.text: How to use voice chat cleanup

tabs.name: Enabling voice chat cleanup
content: Voice chat cleanup is disabled by default. To enable it, use the e!togglevoicechatcleanup/serverconfig toggle voicechatcleanup command. Wynem needs the Manage Messages and Moderate Members permissions to enable it.

data.title: Voice chat cleanup enabled
data.description: I will now delete messages sent in voice channel chats while nobody is in the voice channel

content: Once enabled, it applies to every voice channel in the server.

tabs.name: Disabling voice chat cleanup
content: To disable voice chat cleanup, use the e!togglevoicechatcleanup/serverconfig toggle voicechatcleanup command again.

data.title: Voice chat cleanup disabled
data.description: I will no longer delete messages sent in empty voice channel chats

description: Members who keep sending messages in an empty voice channel chat are timed out automatically. A message counts towards a timeout when it is sent within a minute of that member's previous message, and every message restarts that minute. Sending 3 messages in a row like this times the member out for 20 minutes, and they are sent a direct message about it.

author: Timed out
/assets/images/icons/speaker_red.webp
data.description: You have been timed out in `Wynem and friends`
fields: [AUTO-TIMEOUT] Spamming in an empty voice channel chat

rows: Messages sent by moderators are never deleted.
Only one warning is shown in a channel at a time. It is deleted once a minute has passed without any new messages in that chat.
When someone joins the voice channel, the warning is deleted and every member's message count for that channel is reset.
Automatic timeouts are saved as moderation records, the same as timeouts given by a moderator.

If Wynem loses the Moderate Members permission, messages are still deleted but members are no longer timed out. If it loses the Manage Messages permission, voice chat cleanup is disabled and Wynem sends a notice to the server.
